text:
incidentbot: [ALERT] failed to deliver paging to team=infra via pager-proxy (upstream 502). request_id=rp-7f3b. Channel #incidents has routing.muted=true, page suppressed. Automated fallback: none.

mike: didn't get a page on phone, i'm on-call and reachable — confirming device ok :phone:

lisa: quick context — we had a deploy last night that updated channel routing flags. pager bridge respects the channel mute flag; if it's set pages are suppressed. can someone check notify-proxy logs for 502/timeout to sms-gw?

alex: tailing notify-proxy logs now. seeing repeated 502s to sms-gw and a bunch of 422s from the channel config service. example: 
```
2026-03-18T14:01:02Z notify-proxy rp-7f3b -> sms-gw 502 timeout (connect=2s)
2026-03-18T14:01:03Z config-client 422 get channel #incidents routing.muted=true
```
I'll attempt a manual retry to the SMS fallback endpoint and also try a restart of the notify-proxy deployment if retries fail.

mike: manual SMS came through at 14:03 (thanks alex). customers on-call reported only a single delayed alert. Looks like no widespread customer impact yet, but some delayed internal pages.

sara: ops runbook reminder — when incidentbot suppresses pages due to channel mute, run the manual pager command and escalate if >2 mins. Example command: 
```
/ops manual-pager --team infra --reason "incidentbot suppressed" --via sms --message "URGENT: infra alert"
```

tom: I just rolled notify-proxy: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/notify-proxy` and watching pods. will post if errors persist.

alex: post-restart health check shows 200s to sms-gw and successful page deliveries. sample: 
```
2026-03-18T14:05:21Z notify-proxy rp-7f3b -> sms-gw 200 OK (latency 180ms)
```
Root cause: channel config service returned an unexpected payload during last deploy which set routing.muted=true for #incidents for a short window. Patch to config-client validation in PR #2345.

lisa: assigning postmortem to alex. please include timeline, customer impact (minimal, one delayed alert), detection (we missed an automation alert for mute toggles), and remediation (add a config validation + alert on channel mute flips).

mike: filing customer update and marking severity P2. thanks all for quick manual fallback. :thumbsup:
